const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), defaults={name:'떠기',role:'디지털팀 · 주임',phone:'010-8453-3351',email:'wooy6456@naver.com'};let card={...defaults};const fields=['name','role','phone','email'];
function clean(x){const o={...defaults};for(const k of fields)if(typeof x?.[k]==='string')o[k]=x[k].replace(/[\r\n\u0000]/g,'').slice(0,k==='email'?120:70);return o}
try{if(location.hash.startsWith('#card=')){card=clean(JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(6))))}else{card=clean(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ikfood-tteogi-card-v3')||'{}'))}}catch{}
function link(id,value,scheme){const el=$(id);el.classList.toggle('disabled',!value);el.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(!value));if(value)el.href=scheme+value;else el.removeAttribute('href')}
function render(){$('#name').textContent=card.name||'떠기';$('#role').textContent=card.role||'핫이슈샵';$('#phoneText').textContent=card.phone||'연락처를 입력해주세요';$('#mailText').textContent=card.email||'이메일을 입력해주세요';const phone=card.phone.replace(/[^+\d]/g,'');link('#call',phone,'tel:');link('#phoneLink',phone,'tel:');link('#emailBtn',card.email,'mailto:');link('#mailLink',card.email,'mailto:');document.title=(card.name?card.name+' | ':'')+'IK FOOD 모바일 명함'}render();
let timer;function toast(s){$('#toast').textContent=s;$('#toast').classList.add('show');clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').classList.remove('show'),3200)}
$('#edit').onclick=()=>{for(const k of fields)$('#form').elements[k].value=card[k];$('#editor').showModal()};$('#cancel').onclick=()=>$('#editor').close();$('#form').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();card=clean(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.target)));try{localStorage.setItem('ikfood-tteogi-card-v3',JSON.stringify(card))}catch{}history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search+'#card='+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(card)));render();$('#editor').close();toast('명함 정보가 적용되었습니다')};
function ready(){if(!card.name){$('#edit').click();return false}return true}
$('#download').onclick=()=>{if(!ready())return;const esc=s=>s.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/;/g,'\\;').replace(/,/g,'\\,');const v=['BEGIN:VCARD','VERSION:3.0','FN:'+esc(card.name),'N:'+esc(card.name)+';;;;','ORG:(주)아이케이푸드','TITLE:'+esc(card.role),'TEL;TYPE=WORK:07042949594','ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;경기도 부천시 오정구 삼작로 115번길65;부천시;;14451;대한민국','URL:https://www.ik-food.com',...(card.phone?['TEL;TYPE=CELL:'+card.phone]:[]),...(card.email?['EMAIL:'+esc(card.email)]:[]),'END:VCARD'].join('\r\n');const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([v],{type:'text/vcard;charset=utf-8'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=card.name+'_핫이슈샵.vcf';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),1000);toast('다운로드한 연락처 파일을 열어 저장해주세요')};
$('#share').onclick=async()=>{if(!ready())return;const url=location.origin+location.pathname+'#card='+encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(card));try{if(navigator.share){await navigator.share({title:card.name+' | 핫이슈샵',url})}else{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);toast('명함 링크를 복사했습니다')}}catch(e){if(e.name!=='AbortError'){window.prompt('아래 명함 링크를 복사해주세요',url)}}};
</script></body></html>
